mapper.select: SELECT id, create_by AS createBy, update_by AS updateBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, deleted, version, user_id AS userId, wordbook_id AS wordbookId, material_id AS materialId, sentence_index AS sentenceIndex, target_word AS targetWord, surface_form AS surfaceForm, sentence_text AS sentenceText, copy_count AS copyCount, last_copy_accuracy AS lastCopyAccuracy, cloze_attempt_count AS clozeAttemptCount, cloze_assisted_count AS clozeAssistedCount, cloze_independent_passed AS clozeIndependentPassed, mastery_settled AS masterySettled, last_practiced_time AS lastPracticedTime FROM learning_rumination_sentence_practice WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND sentence_index = #{sentenceIndex} AND target_word = #{targetWord} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
